message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "v3" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "v3" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Harden Runner
      uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76 # v2.14.0
      with:
        egress-policy: audit

    - uses: actions/checkout@8e8c483db84b4bee98b60c0593521ed34d9990e8 # v6.0.1

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@4dc6199c7b1a012772edbd06daecab0f50c9053c # v6.1.0
      with:
        go-version: 1.21

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}

    - name: Build
      run: go build -v ./...

    - name: Test
      run: go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.txt -covermode=atomic ./...

    - name: Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@671740ac38dd9b0130fbe1cec585b89eea48d3de # v5.5.2",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI job that fetches and builds dependencies on every run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) is supported by measured Go workflow evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) showing elapsed-time savings from caching the Go module cache after checkout/setup and before build/test. The repository contains go.mod/go.sum files, so the cache input keyed on lockfiles is valid. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod preserves all existing steps (build, race-enabled test with coverage, Codecov) and permissions, adds no secrets, publishing, deployment, or privileged actions, and introduces no new network destination beyond the existing GitHub Actions cache service already implied by the actions used.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
